1.t: By those who set the ranks in battle order

2.t: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

3.t: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,

4.t: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;

5.t: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.

6.t: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

7.t: With security from every froward devil.

8.t: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,

9.t: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;

10.t: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

11.t: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.

12.t: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

13.t: And heed not when they are reminded,

14.t: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.

15.t: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;

16.t: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?

18.t: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.

19.t: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,

20.t: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.

21.t: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.

22.t: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

23.t: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;

24.t: And stop them, for they must be questioned.

25.t: What aileth you that ye help not one another?

26.t: Nay, but this day they make full submission.

27.t: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

28.t: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).

29.t: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.

30.t: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.

31.t: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).

32.t: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.

33.t: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.

34.t: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.

35.t: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

36.t: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?

37.t: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).

38.t: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -

39.t: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -

41.t: For them there is a known provision,

42.t: Fruits. And they will be honoured

45.t: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,

47.t: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.

48.t: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,

49.t: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).

50.t: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

51.t: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

52.t: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?

53.t: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?

55.t: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.

56.t: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,

57.t: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).

58.t: Are we then not to die

59.t: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?

60.t: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.

61.t: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.

62.t: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?

63.t: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.

64.t: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.

65.t: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

66.t: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.

67.t: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water

68.t: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.

69.t: They indeed found their fathers astray,

70.t: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.

71.t: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,

72.t: And verily We sent among them warners.

73.t: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,

75.t: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

76.t: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,

77.t: And made his seed the survivors,

78.t: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

79.t: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!

80.t: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

81.t: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

82.t: Then We did drown the others.

83.t: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

84.t: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

85.t: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?

86.t: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

87.t: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?

88.t: And he glanced a glance at the stars

89.t: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

90.t: And they turned their backs and went away from him.

91.t: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?

92.t: What aileth you that ye speak not?

93.t: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.

94.t: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.

95.t: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

96.t: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

97.t: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

98.t: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

99.t: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

100.t: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

101.t: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

102.t: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.

103.t: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,

104.t: We called unto him: O Abraham!

105.t: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

106.t: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

107.t: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.

108.t: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

110.t: Thus do We reward the good.

111.t: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

112.t: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.

113.t: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.

114.t: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,

115.t: And saved them and their people from the great distress,

116.t: And helped them so that they became the victors.

117.t: And We gave them the clear Scripture

118.t: And showed them the right path.

119.t: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):

120.t: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!

121.t: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

122.t: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.

123.t: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),

124.t: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

125.t: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,

126.t: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?

127.t: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

129.t: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

131.t: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

132.t: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.

133.t: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).

134.t: When We saved him and his household, every one,

135.t: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;

137.t: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

138.t: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?

139.t: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

140.t: When he fled unto the laden ship,

141.t: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;

142.t: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;

143.t: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

144.t: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;

145.t: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;

146.t: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

147.t: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

148.t: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.

149.t: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?

150.t: Or created We the angels females while they were present?

151.t: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:

152.t: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.

153.t: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.

154.t: What aileth you? How judge ye?

156.t: Or have ye a clear warrant?

157.t: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.

158.t: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).

159.t: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),

161.t: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,

163.t: Save him who is to burn in hell.

164.t: There is not one of us but hath his known position.

165.t: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,

166.t: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise

167.t: And indeed they used to say:

168.t: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

169.t: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.

170.t: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.

171.t: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

172.t: That they verily would be helped,

173.t: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.

174.t: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,

175.t: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

176.t: Would they hasten on Our doom?

177.t: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.

179.t: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

180.t: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

181.t: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).

182.t: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
